lore_anchors.definition: A being born from the primordial chaos with instinctive mastery over an entire Heavenly Dao, representing the highest level of natural-born power.
The supreme metaphysical laws that govern the universe, such as Life, Death, Yin, and Yang. There are only ten in total.
A powerful but lesser metaphysical law compared to a Heavenly Dao. There are eighty-one in total, and True Gods are born with mastery over one.
The supreme Daoist deity who achieved ultimate power by reincarnating nine times to comprehend opposing Heavenly Daos.
Divine stones refined by Nuwa from the quintessence of the Five Elements to repair the broken heavens.
The legendary pillar-mountain formed from Pangu's spine, broken by the Water Elder God Gonggong.
